import sqlite3

                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

        self.review_label.pack()
        self.review_entry = tk.Entry(self.review_frame)
        self.review_entry.pack()
        self.review_button = tk.Button(self.review_frame, text="Add Review", command=self.add_review)

        book_title = self.book_entry.get()
        self.cursor.execute("INSERT INTO books (title) VALUES (?)", (book_title,))
        self.conn.commit()

        review = self.review_entry.get()
        user_id = self.get_user_id()
        book_id = self.get_book_id()
        self.cursor.execute("INSERT INTO reviews (user_id, book_id, rating, review) VALUES (?, ?, 5, ?)", (user_id, book_id, review))
        self.conn.commit()

    def get_user_id(self):
        user_name = self.user_entry.get()
        self.cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ?", (user_name,))
        return self.cursor.fetchone()[0]

    def get_book_id(self):
        book_title = self.book_entry.get()
        self.cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM books WHERE title = ?", (book_title,))
        return self.cursor.fetchone()[0]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = BookReviewTracker(root)
    root.mainloop()
